input.summary: Narrow the restriction on the Company to the branded Deerskin site during the term
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept restrictions on the businesses we operate or the products we sell, so we have narrowed Section 6.1 to a self-contained "Deerskin"-branded consumer site during the term only, with our other channels, internal development and acquisitions carved out. Deleting the restriction entirely remains our preferred position.

ops.oldText: the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and
ops.newText: the Company shall not establish a self-contained "Deerskin" branded web site offering Deerskin Products directly to consumers on the Internet, provided that this restriction shall not apply to the Company's other sales channels, catalogs or web sites, to products other than Deerskin Products, to the Company's internal development activities, or to any business acquired by the Company, and

input.summary: Add performance-based termination of HDI's exclusivity
input.comment: [Playbook] We keep the freedom to source elsewhere, so HDI's exclusivity must end automatically if HDI fails to perform. We have limited the exclusive right to the term and added an automatic termination on HDI's failure to meet the launch date or to operate the Site reliably; exclusivity that runs in our favour (Section 6.3) is unchanged.

ops.text: HDI's exclusive right under this Section 6.1 shall terminate automatically, and the Company shall be free to procure equivalent services from any third party, if HDI fails to have the Site fully operational within the period specified in Section 1.6 or fails to operate and maintain the Site in accordance with this Agreement and does not cure such failure within thirty (30) days of written notice.
